name: social-short-form-writer
description: Claude Code plugin that converts blog posts into native Instagram + TikTok + Threads captions. Photo-mode focused (4:5 carousel for IG, 9:16 vertical for TikTok, text/4:5 carousel for Threads). Authors English captions for IG/TikTok and ID+EN bilingual for Threads, hashtag-rule-aware (IG 3-5, TikTok 5-8, Threads 0-3), hook-first formulas, anti-AI-slop. Pure content generation — emits draft JSON for an admin panel to consume.
author: Ali Sadikin <ali.sadikincom85@gmail.com>
